parameters.formDescription: Generate a complete network automation project for your client. This will create documentation, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines delivered to a Git repository.

options.formSubmittedText: Your network automation project is being generated. You will receive a notification when complete.

parameters.jsCode:
// Generate CI/CD Pipeline files
const data = $input.first().json;
const { clientData, infrastructure, delivery, files } = data;

const target = delivery.target;
const configMgmtTool = infrastructure.configMgmtTool;
const iacTool = infrastructure.iacTool;

if (target === 'GitLab') {
  // GitLab CI/CD Pipeline
  let gitlabCi = `# GitLab CI/CD Pipeline for ${clientData.companyName}

stages:
  - validate
  - plan
  - deploy
  - backup

variables:
  NETWORK_USERNAME: $NETWORK_USERNAME
  NETWORK_PASSWORD: $NETWORK_PASSWORD

# Validation Stage
`;

  if (configMgmtTool.includes('Ansible')) {
    gitlabCi += `ansible-lint:
  stage: validate
  image: cytopia/ansible-lint:latest
  script:
    - ansible-lint config-management/ansible/playbooks/*.yml
  only:
    changes:
      - config-management/ansible/**/*

`;
  }

  if (iacTool === 'Terraform') {
    gitlabCi += `terraform-validate:
  stage: validate
  image: hashicorp/terraform:latest
  script:
    - cd iac/terraform
    - terraform init -backend=false
    - terraform validate
  only:
    changes:
      - iac/terraform/**/*

terraform-plan:
  stage: plan
  image: hashicorp/terraform:latest
  script:
    - cd iac/terraform
    - terraform init
    - terraform plan -out=tfplan
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - iac/terraform/tfplan
  only:
    - merge_requests

terraform-apply:
  stage: deploy
  image: hashicorp/terraform:latest
  script:
    - cd iac/terraform
    - terraform init
    - terraform apply -auto-approve
  when: manual
  only:
    - main

`;
  }

  if (iacTool === 'Pulumi') {
    gitlabCi += `pulumi-preview:
  stage: plan
  image: pulumi/pulumi-python:latest
  script:
    - cd iac/pulumi
    - pip install -r requirements.txt
    - pulumi preview
  only:
    - merge_requests

pulumi-up:
  stage: deploy
  image: pulumi/pulumi-python:latest
  script:
    - cd iac/pulumi
    - pip install -r requirements.txt
    - pulumi up --yes
  when: manual
  only:
    - main

`;
  }

  if (configMgmtTool.includes('Ansible')) {
    gitlabCi += `ansible-deploy:
  stage: deploy
  image: cytopia/ansible:latest
  script:
    - cd config-management/ansible
    - ansible-playbook playbooks/deploy.yml
  when: manual
  only:
    - main

ansible-backup:
  stage: backup
  image: cytopia/ansible:latest
  script:
    - cd config-management/ansible
    - ansible-playbook playbooks/backup.yml
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"

`;
  }

  if (configMgmtTool.includes('Nornir')) {
    gitlabCi += `nornir-deploy:
  stage: deploy
  image: python:3.11
  before_script:
    - pip install -r requirements.txt
  script:
    - cd config-management/nornir
    - python deploy.py
  when: manual
  only:
    - main

nornir-backup:
  stage: backup
  image: python:3.11
  before_script:
    - pip install -r requirements.txt
  script:
    - cd config-management/nornir
    - python backup.py
  rules:
    - if: $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule"

`;
  }

  files.push({ path: '.gitlab-ci.yml', content: gitlabCi });

} else if (target === 'GitHub') {
  // GitHub Actions Workflows
  
  // Validation workflow
  let validateWorkflow = `name: Validate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
`;

  if (configMgmtTool.includes('Ansible')) {
    validateWorkflow += `  ansible-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run ansible-lint
        uses: ansible/ansible-lint@main
        with:
          targets: config-management/ansible/playbooks/

`;
  }

  if (iacTool === 'Terraform') {
    validateWorkflow += `  terraform-validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
      - name: Terraform Init
        working-directory: iac/terraform
        run: terraform init -backend=false
      - name: Terraform Validate
        working-directory: iac/terraform
        run: terraform validate

`;
  }

  files.push({ path: '.github/workflows/validate.yml', content: validateWorkflow });

  // Deploy workflow
  let deployWorkflow = `name: Deploy

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target:
        description: 'Deployment target'
        required: true
        default: 'all'
        type: choice
        options:
          - all
          - infrastructure
          - config

env:
  NETWORK_USERNAME: \${{ secrets.NETWORK_USERNAME }}
  NETWORK_PASSWORD: \${{ secrets.NETWORK_PASSWORD }}

jobs:
`;

  if (iacTool === 'Terraform') {
    deployWorkflow += `  terraform:
    if: \${{ inputs.target == 'all' || inputs.target == 'infrastructure' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v3
      - name: Terraform Init
        working-directory: iac/terraform
        run: terraform init
      - name: Terraform Apply
        working-directory: iac/terraform
        run: terraform apply -auto-approve

`;
  }

  if (iacTool === 'Pulumi') {
    deployWorkflow += `  pulumi:
    if: \${{ inputs.target == 'all' || inputs.target == 'infrastructure' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: iac/pulumi
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - uses: pulumi/actions@v5
        with:
          command: up
          stack-name: prod
          work-dir: iac/pulumi

`;
  }

  if (configMgmtTool.includes('Ansible')) {
    deployWorkflow += `  ansible:
    if: \${{ inputs.target == 'all' || inputs.target == 'config' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install Ansible
        run: pip install ansible
      - name: Run Ansible Playbook
        working-directory: config-management/ansible
        run: ansible-playbook playbooks/deploy.yml

`;
  }

  if (configMgmtTool.includes('Nornir')) {
    deployWorkflow += `  nornir:
    if: \${{ inputs.target == 'all' || inputs.target == 'config' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run Nornir Deploy
        working-directory: config-management/nornir
        run: python deploy.py

`;
  }

  files.push({ path: '.github/workflows/deploy.yml', content: deployWorkflow });

  // Backup workflow (scheduled)
  let backupWorkflow = `name: Backup

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'  # Daily at 2 AM
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  NETWORK_USERNAME: \${{ secrets.NETWORK_USERNAME }}
  NETWORK_PASSWORD: \${{ secrets.NETWORK_PASSWORD }}

jobs:
  backup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
`;

  if (configMgmtTool.includes('Ansible')) {
    backupWorkflow += `      - name: Install Ansible
        run: pip install ansible
      - name: Run Backup Playbook
        working-directory: config-management/ansible
        run: ansible-playbook playbooks/backup.yml
`;
  } else if (configMgmtTool.includes('Nornir')) {
    backupWorkflow += `      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - name: Run Nornir Backup
        working-directory: config-management/nornir
        run: python backup.py
`;
  }

  backupWorkflow += `      - name: Commit backups
        run: |
          git config user.name github-actions
          git config user.email github-actions@github.com
          git add .
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "Automated backup \$(date +%Y-%m-%d)"
          git push
`;

  files.push({ path: '.github/workflows/backup.yml', content: backupWorkflow });
}

return {
  json: {
    ...data,
    files
  }
};
